landed.comment: The proof check.sh --landed runs for this page. 9d5c8220 wrote the rule, 9936020a held it against main's rewrite of merge-gate.md, 94d75564 wrote that an APPROVE needs both halves run, and caaf84f9 wrote it as it stands, admitting both pair rows reading not run for the reason they state, so the page names caaf84f9. The proof is the guard test, whose test of the combining rule holds the clause as caaf84f9 wrote it, and that test fails against merge-gate.md of main at c95e698a9a5fe38e1673f7abcc96c6bf80cda88a, of bcc01d05cac9d7f82bc3b1df799489fed9ee64fe and of bfe1471e3b662125ed2ea103278d41bf3e5f6dd5, which are the three spellings before 94d75564, and of 94d75564, whose clause ends 'or the two not run rows above', so the proof exits 1 against each. published lists the sentences this step added that check.sh --published reads in merge-gate.md on the default branch.
